questions.name: q1_what_can_i_do
questions.question: What can I do at Engineer Cafe?
questions.answer: You can work at our coworking area with free Wi-Fi or rent engineering equipment like drones in the Main Hall for demos and rentals. We also have a B1F fabrication lab available for prototyping, plus paid meeting rooms and drinks on the second floor.

questions.name: q3_cafe_open_weekend
questions.question: Is the cafe open on weekends?
questions.answer: Yes, the cafe is open on weekends according to our schedule. It remains available for guests on Saturdays and Sundays each week.
